description: This source file defines the 'Development' class, which extends LauncherActivity and customizes the handling of intent targeting and sorting results for developer-related settings in Android.

classes.name: Development
classes.description: A subclass of LauncherActivity that customizes intent targeting and sorts developer setting results by adding the top resolution activity for developer settings.

methods.name: getTargetIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent targeted at main launcher activities with the category 'CATEGORY_TEST'.

methods.name: onSortResultList
methods.description: Overrides default sorting to prioritize the developer settings activity by adding the highest-priority resolve info for the settings intent.
